comment: Twice now this season, I yanked the eventual winner from my original lineup before an opening round – Chris Gotterup (WM Phoenix Open) and Gary Woodland (Texas Children’s) – so I’m my own worst enemy. It’s proof that fantasy golf can be just as aggravating as the real thing.
